type: M9 PRE-REGISTRATION -- paired rotation-transfer probe on real data
motivation: M7 was underpowered: 9/53 positives, bootstrap 95% CI on AUROC [0.133, 0.579] which contains chance; ~381 datasets would be needed for AUROC 0.70 at 80% power. This experiment replaces the ill-posed binary task with a paired, continuous, large-effect one derived from the M3 controlled rotation probe.

hypotheses.H1: TabPFN test log-loss INCREASES under rotation of the numeric block (paired one-sided Wilcoxon, alpha=0.05).
hypotheses.H2: strong_classical degrades MORE than TabPFN under the same rotation (paired one-sided), because its tree members are axis-aligned.
hypotheses.H3: rotation_alignment, computed on the UNROTATED training split and frozen at M6, positively predicts the magnitude of TabPFN's degradation (Spearman > 0, one-sided). This is the out-of-prior claim restated on a target with variance to predict.

design.unit: one real dataset, measured twice (original vs rotated) on the SAME split
design.rotation: Haar-random orthogonal map on the standardized numeric block; train moments only; identical matrix for train and test

tuning_budget.note: 2x the M7 budget, to blunt the under-tuned-baseline objection

analysis_plan.H1: Wilcoxon signed-rank on (logloss_rotated - logloss_original) for TabPFN
analysis_plan.stopping_rule: all cells, or report exactly which datasets completed
analysis_plan.no_outcome_dependent_choices: metric, tests and direction are fixed here
